newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australasian says finds more gold.
newsitem.headline: Australasian says finds more gold.

text.p: Australasian Gold Mines NL said on Wednesday it has located a potential new gold field on its Mount Henry property in Western Australia.
The property includes the Aphrodite, Cybele Selene and Mount Henry deposits.

"Within the Mt Henry mineralised system, a reverse circulation drilling campaign has extended the Mt Henry and Selene deposits and identified the potential for high grade reef quartz structures in the basalt hanging wall of the Mt Henry shear," the company said.
Total resources in the Mt Henry system are 14.31 million tonnes grading 1.65 grammes of gold per tonne, or 759,000 ounces, the company said in its March quarter production report.
